scope: Bounded existing sales assignment UI and additive compatible backend. Development checkpoint only; not a whole-app redesign.
instructions: docs/design/stitch/task-ui-2026-10-08/DESIGN.md; shared @cp/ui task controls; protected welcome and accepted slices preserved.

featureMapping.before: /cs/sales-assignment: search, one-company local selection and immediate PATCH save
featureMapping.after: /cs/sales-assignment and /assign: scoped native company search, explicit 1–20 company selection, eligible roster and local selection recovery

featureMapping.before: Save without a separately navigable review
featureMapping.after: /cs/sales-assignment/assign/review?companies=<ids>&owner=<id|clear>: current native owners, imported account scope and explicit confirmation before dispatch

featureMapping.before: Any resolved HTTP save treated as assignment success
featureMapping.after: /cs/sales-assignment/requests/:uuid: owner-private immutable committed receipt; only matched complete persistence produces success count

Preserved payload/response, permission and original ownership/eligibility/business rules. Legacy single-company writer joins the shared company advisory lock. Existing legacy controls remain available.

api.readModel: Company names/IDs from original JoshCustomers narrow reader; current owner/version from Commerce company_sales_reps. Counts reflect nondeleted imported customer copies, with upstream freshness explicitly unverified.
api.saveModel: Strict immutable request UUID + nullable new rep + unique company IDs/reviewed SHA256 versions; 1–20 companies; owner derived only from authenticated staff. UUIDs canonicalized before uniqueness and locking.

permissions.alias: sale_manager normalizes through the original active DB StaffAuthGuard
permissions.ownership: New review/save requires COMMERCE_OWNS_SALES_REPS exactly true. Committed original requests remain readable/replayable under original authorized roles after source/ownership changes.
permissions.eligibleOwner: Original staffRosterSql sale/sales/manager rules, active Commerce roster and unlinked active internal Josh roster; null clears. No permission grants or roster expansion.

invariants: Company must exist in native assignment import or nondeleted customer copy, as in the original service. Original narrow replica confirms selected company identity.

Recorded same-owner companies remain visible with previous/new owner evidence during review and disable confirmation; the save independently rejects them rather than manufacturing completed assignments. An absent Commerce row is labeled explicitly and never presented as verified upstream unassigned ownership.
Every selected native version and customer-copy scope is revalidated under sorted company locks before any assignment.
Any invalid/stale member, unavailable source, event insert failure or receipt persistence failure rolls the entire batch back.
Native company assignments, original company.sales_rep transactional outbox events and durable receipt commit together. Outbox delivery is explicitly unverified.
Same actor/request/body returns original persisted receipt without repeating assignments/events. Different packet or cross-kind request collision conflicts.
Actor-private recovery does not infer save success from current owner equality, counters, generic responses or a missing receipt.
Immutable owner-scoped local recovery journal is verified before dispatch; storage failure prevents sending. Repeated clicks are synchronously locked.

Known absent receipt plus matching current review permits only explicitly confirmed original retry. Stale/ineligible evidence blocks retry. Known rejected requests can return to fresh selection after confirmed receipt absence.
Cancellation/back navigation does not dispatch; a late response cannot redirect a newer navigation. Already dispatched operations are reconciled through their original request.
interactionStates: Accessible labels and explicit company scope, previous/new owner and imported customer count
Shared task controls, inline errors and selected-scope feedback
Fluid mobile controls, wrapping identities and locale-aware Thai/English copy
Success count only from complete authoritative committed receipt; previous receipt is historical rather than current owner proof

externalReview.claude: Did not start on Dot: no installation; official installer returned 403. No proposal produced or integrated. No authentication attempted in this executor.

remainingDependencies: Production availability/permissions of existing company_sales_reps, customer copies, staff roster/link tables, outbox and private request storage remain unverified. No production connection or application migration was used.

Company identities and imported customer account counts depend on existing copies/read replica; upstream freshness is not established. A committed native receipt does not prove downstream Josh delivery.
Request journal uses existing private draft storage with a customer_assignment discriminator. Production retention, indexing and throughput budgets need approved follow-up.

Review intentionally caps at 20 selected companies. Full-catalog selection, bulk-all-filtered assignment, reassignment of separate winback opportunity owners, branch ownership, notifications and permissions changes are outside this slice.
Other legacy menus and pages remain in the route inventory. This checkpoint does not complete the overall navigation redesign.

validation.authenticationBoundary: Browser identity transport is synthetic; native SQL/domain/controller/outbox persistence is real in isolated owned namespaces. HTTP checks use original StaffAuthGuard with a synthetic active-user repository. Not production/full-real-auth E2E.
